params.name: drawStopIndicator
params.default: { drawStopIndicator(drawScope = this, stopSize = ProgressIndicatorDefaults.LinearTrackStopIndicatorSize, color = color, strokeCap = strokeCap,) }

doc.progress: the progress of this progress indicator, where 0.0 represents no progress and 1.0 represents full progress. Values outside of this range are coerced into the range.
doc.modifier: the [Modifier] to be applied to this progress indicator
doc.trackColor: color of the track behind the indicator, visible when the progress has not reached the area of the overall indicator yet
doc.strokeCap: stroke cap to use for the ends of this progress indicator
doc.gapSize: size of the gap between the progress indicator and the track
doc.drawStopIndicator: lambda that will be called to draw the stop indicator. Note that a custom indicator implementation should also handle RTL layouts.
